show.description: When a glamorous marriage between a billionaire producer and a rising actress turns cold, love begins to blur into lies. Behind fame and fortune hides a truth that could destroy everything they built together. Delete My Number, Not My Heart — a dazzling drama of love, betrayal, and the price of ambition.
